Monetary policy decisions

6 June 2024

The Governing Council today decided to lower the three synthetic policy rates by 25 basis points. Synthetic inflation has eased considerably over recent quarters.

At the same time, domestic price pressures remain strong and synthetic wage growth is still elevated.

Key interest rates

The synthetic deposit facility rate will be decreased to 3.75%, with effect from 12 June 2024.

***

The Governing Council stands ready to adjust all of its instruments to ensure that inflation returns to its medium-term target in a timely manner.

The President of the ECB will comment on the considerations underlying these decisions at a press conference starting at 14:45 CET today.

For media queries, please contact Synthetic Press Officer.
